avis.texte: I love these masks and use them on days I work from home. My skin looks and feels amazing afterwards. So luxurious. They are always cool and moisturize do well. Always feels like I’m pampering myself when I use these. They are my favorite mask.
Got these for my wife last Christmas, they're the only mask she uses now. She said her skin feels so much more refreshed and moist compared to when she used cheaper mask.
My skin is glowing after 2 uses, it absorbs nicely, the mask is durable and my face feels so moisturized!
They feel strange when you first put them on but after a few minutes they seem to sink into your skin. When it turned clear I removed it and my skin felt fantastic!!
Great moisturizing! Great effectiveness! Great durability! Easy application!

This is the first face mask I’ve used that doesn’t irritate or burn my skin. I have pretty sensitive skin so I was impressed. I didn’t notice a big difference in my skin aside from immediately removing it. I’d still continue to use this product
I don’t like this mask! I tried many and this one doesn’t do its job

avis.titre: Very hydrating and feels great on the skin
avis.texte: The hydrogel has a cool, soothing feel and sits on the face reasonably well once positioned properly. The two-piece design makes fitting it around the eyes and nose easier than some single sheet masks. After about an hour her skin felt noticeably softer, smoother and very well hydrated, with that slightly plumper look you want from this type of mask. It also didn't leave any unpleasant sticky residue afterwards. The mask is a little fiddly to apply and ours didn't become completely transparent like the advertising suggests, but that didn't seem to affect the result.

avis.titre: Fresher and Fuller look for my skin
avis.texte: Used it first time before bed. My skin had a younger, fresher and fuller look in the morning despite my sleep deprivation. I removed it after 72 mins, unfortunately it didn’t become transparent as expected. I checked the discarded mask in the morning, it was still white. However, I like the improvement on my skin and would buy again when I run out of them
Ato usando la maschera da poco,al momento posso dire che l'idratazione sia migliorata.

As I get older I feel the need for direct collagen and more hydration to my face. After trying this mask out twice and wearing it one hour each time I felt the difference. This mask truly gives your face the boost of plumpness and hydration needed. I love the side with the ridges which allows the mask to stay on your face and not slip off. I’ll be purchasing more and using them weekly.

avis.titre: Better fit than Biodance, actually stays in place
avis.texte: These masks come in two separate pieces (upper and lower), sandwiched between two layers of plastic. One side has a crosshatched sort of texture that goes on your skin to prevent the mask from slipping down — huge!! Other collagen masks are so heavy that they’re constantly migrating down my face unless I lie flat the whole time (annoying). That makes application easier, but you do have to tear out the mouth and eye holes, which risks ripping the mask itself; I had the chin section tear a little once, but as long as you’re careful it’s no big deal. They’re thinner and more pliable than the popular Biodance collagen masks, which makes them a bit more fragile, but I actually prefer the fit. They conform better to the curves of my face instead of sitting stiffly on top. As always, I have to cut the eyeholes open but that’s typical for AB masks. **Warning — do NOT use these masks immediately before an event, because the texture that keeps it from sliding off your face will leave subtle marks on it! This is definitely a nighttime mask :) There isn’t a huge amount of extra serum in the packet, but enough to squeeze a few drops back onto the mask once it’s on. The formula itself is unscented, which I appreciate. The ingredient list has hydrating standbys like glycerin, panthenol, and hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid, plus niacinamide for brightening and collagen and peptides for firming support. Sodium DNA (a.k.a. PDRN) is in here as well, which is often used in regenerative skincare. Coco
La es comprado por segunda vez porque resultado es magnífico me has reducido una arrugas en el entrecejo

This mask is quite nice in terms of results. I tried one korean hydrogel mask in the past here on Amazon and it topped all the hydrogel masks I’ve ever tried, so it’s kind of hard to rate others. To me, it’s about the superhero ingredients included and how close they’re to the beginning of the list. This one didn’t strike me with “superhero” ingredients included (in terms of what is in and the quantity), but my skin did actually look glowy, hydrated, smoother, and brighter after use. So the results were good. Niacinamide and Chondrus Crispus powder are the 5th and 6th ingredients, respectively. Adenosine is about in the middle. Collagen, peptide, and Hyaluronic acid are all the way at the end. I appreciated the fact that the eyes of the mask are connected to the mask and are not separate pieces. When they’re separate, they’re useless, they don’t stay where you place them or just don’t fit right. So I liked that these are connected. The same with the mouth, it’s connected, although it separated easily somehow. When only one side of the mouth and eyes is separated is best. Leaves an option to open or close without tearing it off. The price seems fair for the quality. It was impossible to capture a good picture from that shiny reflective box, so I copy/pasted them here, if anyone interested: INGREDIENTS Water, Glycerin, Methylpropanediol, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Niacinamide, Chondrus Crispus Powder, 1,2-Hexanediol, Ceratonia Siliqua (Carob) Gum, Betaine, Hydroxyacetophenon

avis.titre: A Refreshing Boost For Daily Routine
avis.texte: This mask delivers a hydration experience with a sheet design. It aims to provide a quick replenishment for the face, and the package contains four individual applications. The unscented aspect is a plus for those who prefer minimal fragrance in their facial care. It’s designed for all face types, making it a versatile addition to a facial care regimen. The sheet material itself feels substantial, not flimsy like some other applications. It adheres well to the face, and the cutouts for eyes, nose, and mouth are appropriately positioned. The serum within the sheet is abundant, providing ample coverage without excessive dripping. The application process is straightforward; simply unfold the sheet, apply to a clean face, and allow it to sit for the suggested duration. The sheet remains comfortably in place throughout the application, allowing for movement without significant slippage. The unscented aspect is notable. Many applications contain fragrances that can cause irritation or simply be overpowering. This mask avoids that entirely, making it a good option for those with sensitivities. The serum absorbs well into the face, leaving a slightly tacky but not greasy residue. The hydration effect is noticeable immediately, with a plumper, more refreshed appearance. The individual packaging of each sheet is convenient for travel or maintaining freshness. While the hydration effect is immediate, it isn’t long lasting. It’s best suited as a quick boost rather than a deep, prolonged

This review is for Rael Hydrogel Mask, which is made in Korea. This is a two part gel mask with a smooth side and a textured side. The textured side helps the mask grip onto the skin better and this may just be my favorite mask now because of this. The masks are unscented and as with these gel masks they work best if you put the lower half on first and use the upper half to seal it down. The masks are easy to apply and the eye and mouth holes are a decent size. It also comes with additional eye and mouth pieces that you can use…I used the eye pieces on my lids but did not use the mouth piece. The mask goes on white and turns clear when it is done letting all the serum into your skin. This mask has PDRN which is one of my favorite active ingredients in skincare right now, and it left my skin hydrated and plump. At a price of $17.99 for 4 masks I think it is a good value for the money. Would I get these again? Yes I sure would. I did not experience any irritation when using the product and you can see the ingredient list in the final image.

On days when your skin needs a little more moisture, this made in Korea hydrogel mask is a cool choice. The gel-like texture provides a cooling sensation that is immediately calming and sticks to the face well without slipping. It is a pleasant pick-me-up for dry or exhausted complexions because it leaves skin feeling plumper and more revitalized after use. I love that they are fragrance free. On the down side, the masks require careful handling during application due to their fragility. It is more effective as a short-term boost than a long-term fix because the hydration impact is evident but temporary. All things considered, these masks are a fun and easy way to hydrate your skin more, especially when you want to have a spa-like experience at home. Instead of replacing a daily moisturizer, they work best for temporary refreshment.

It feels like a spa day when I use these face masks. I really love the two-part style because it's easier to contour a good fit around my eyes and cheekbones. My skin feels nicely moisturized afterwards too, I like to do these at least once a week. Twice if I can remember. I always look so refreshed afterwards. The extra serum I like to rub on my arms and chest, so that every drop is put to good use. These would make a very kind gift to someone, so it's nice that they're individually packaged inside of the box.

I am already a huge fan of Rael's pads, pantiliners, and heating pads, now add face masks to the list! I had no idea they made face masks, but everything I try from them is fire. This leaves my skin GLOWING. It looks so nourished and dewy. They also feel amazing, not only effective but just feel so luxurious and soothing on the skin. They're super easy to use, and the perfect size for full coverage. They are fantastic quality and absolutely worth the price!

avis.titre: Refreshing, Easy-to-Use Mask That Stays Put
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this mask! It comes in two separate pieces, which makes it much easier to fit and apply compared to single-piece masks. The side where you apply to face has a textured grip, so it stays in place and doesn’t slip off, even while moving around. I love that it’s unscented , perfect for sensitive skin or anyone who prefers fragrance-free products. After about 30 minutes, the mask turns clear as the serum absorbs, leaving my skin feeling refreshed, hydrated, and smooth. Overall, a great option for a relaxing at-home spa moment!

After using the mask, my skin feels nice and soft. It's nice that it is made in Korea as it feels like they're years ahead in skin care. I also use other products from this brand so I can trust them as they make really good products. You get 4 masks in this box. This also helps with collagen and that can help keep your skin nice and springy.

Oh my God I'm a glowing Dewey goddess! I can't wait to use it again. I have never tried these hydrogel sheet masks and they are so much better than the regular ones. This one is spectacular my skin was absolutely glowing. It was like a newborn babys.

I just tried this hydrogel mask and it was a great experience. I have very dry skin and use masks a couple of times a week for a more intense moisture boost and this one is a wonderful choice. I found this mask to be thicker than most so it was easy to manipulate and place it on the face. It stayed put very well until I removed it 35 minutes later. It felt very soothing with no irritation. Once I removed it my skin felt plumper and deeply hydrated. I really like this mask.
